title: How is Pablo Escobar connected to Winnie the Pooh?
description:
A TV star, two presidents, a first lady and NBC's Willard Scott connect Pablo Escobar to Winnie the Pooh in six real photos.

Pablo Escobar → Virginia Vallejo → Belisario Betancur → Ronald Reagan → Nancy Reagan → Willard Scott → Winnie the Pooh

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
